quiz.hint: Three sources: two bottoms and the divisor’s top.三处来源：两个分母和除式的分子。
quiz.ans: (x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​, x=5,1,−2(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​，x=5,1,−2
quiz.why: Bottoms: x=5, x=1. Divisor top: x=−2.分母：x=5，x=1。除式分子：x=−2。

quiz.q: A rectangle has area x+1x2−9​ and length x2−1x+3​. Find an expression for its width.一个长方形面积为 x+1x2−9​，长为 x2−1x+3​。求宽的表达式。
quiz.hint: Width = area ÷ length.宽 = 面积 ÷ 长。
quiz.ans: (x−3)(x−1)
quiz.why: x+1(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+3(x−1)(x+1)​=(x−3)(x−1).x+1(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+3(x−1)(x+1)​=(x−3)(x−1)。
